verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships a first-party MCP server explicitly documented to let AI assistants 'generate infrastructure code' from Pulumi Cloud context, and Pulumi Neo lets users 'tell Neo what you need in plain English' to provision infrastructure — both built into the toolchain. A hands-on probe confirms the MCP server actually runs and responds to JSON-RPC handshakes, corroborating the vendor claim beyond just documentation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of actual natural-language-to-IaC code generation quality (only the handshake, not code-gen output, was tested) and no third-party corroboration of Neo's real-world behavior.
